limits: Paired single-iteration observations, not latency quantiles or throughput under concurrency.
Local shared machine; no full-cluster or real VM density capacity claim.
B/op reports cumulative Go allocation, not peak RSS.
SQLite inventories include production row decoding and decryption, but exclude telemetry calculation/export.
File imports use real importSource with stub lease/checkpoint replies and no target Nodes.
Group reports include real streamGroups and ValidateMessage; exclude database snapshot, network transport and Registry publication.
The 10k and 100k quadratic file-import baseline was not run.
